what: EMCOR Group is one of the largest specialty contractors in the United States. It installs and services the electrical and mechanical systems inside buildings and industrial plants: wiring, heating, ventilation, piping and fire protection.
customers: Data centre developers, semiconductor and pharmaceutical plant builders, healthcare and institutional owners, and industrial facilities needing maintenance.
moat: A skilled trade workforce at national scale, which is the binding constraint on large construction projects, plus local relationships in dozens of markets.
risks: Data centre and manufacturing construction is a large share of the backlog, so a pause there would hurt
The shares have risen a long way and trade at a high multiple for a contractor
opportunities: Revenue grew about 17% last year and about 15% a year over three years
Return on invested capital of 31% with cash exceeding debt
Analysts see about 35% upside from current levels
watch: Remaining performance obligations and operating margin by segment.
